name: First Steps
hint: Arrow keys or WASD roll the block. Stand upright on the goal to finish.

name: The Bend
hint: A lying block covers two tiles. Think about which orientation you arrive in.

name: Thin Ice
hint: Orange tiles crack if you stand on them. Roll across lying down.

name: Drawbridge
hint: Touch the round switch (any contact) to raise the bridge.

name: Heavy Duty
hint: Square switches need your full weight — stand upright on them.

name: Zigzag
hint: Count your rolls. Every tip changes which tiles you cover.

name: Crossroads
hint: Fragile tiles can be safe stepping stones — if you never stand on them.

name: Lockstep
hint: Touch the switch twice and the bridge closes again.

name: Two Keys
hint: Two switches, two bridges. Find the order that works.

name: Star Route
hint: Stars are optional — collect all three for a perfect run.

name: Pillars
hint: Narrow corridors force you upright. Wide ones let you lie down.

name: Toggle Trap
hint: The round switch flips BOTH bridges — one opens as the other closes.

name: Island Hop
hint: Sparse and mean. Plan the whole route before the first roll.

name: Gatekeeper
hint: The heavy switch controls the far bridge. You'll need to come back.

name: Long Way
hint: The shortest path is not always the safest.

name: Switchboard
hint: Three switches, three bridges. Every mistake costs a trip back.

name: Glass Bridge
hint: Almost everything is glass. Keep your weight spread.

name: Double Lock
hint: Soft and heavy switches share one bridge. Parity is everything.

name: Labyrinth
hint: Big, sparse and unforgiving. Use the hint button if you must.

name: The Gauntlet
hint: Everything you've learned, all at once. Good luck.
